name: GCW Missouri Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Gateway City Wrestling's top prize, open to any wrestler regardless of weight and slated for defense every three to four weeks -- announced in the fed's own founding guide before any match was ever held.

name: GCW Television Title
epitaph: Gateway City Wrestling's secondary title, restricted to wrestlers under 290 pounds and slated for defense every other week -- announced in the fed's own founding guide before any match was ever held.
